access_issues: MAJOR UNLOCK, reusable: tender.privatbank.ua is an AngularJS SPA whose search API previously rejected headless calls. Route that works with plain curl and a desktop Chrome User-Agent: (1) GET https://tender.privatbank.ua/commercial/ to obtain a JSESSIONID cookie scoped to /commercial; (2) GET https://tender.privatbank.ua/commercial/tender and read the Spring CSRF token out of the inline script line `var csrf = {name: "_csrf", headerName: "X-CSRF-TOKEN", value: "<uuid>"};`; (3) POST that cookie plus header X-CSRF-TOKEN to https://tender.privatbank.ua/commercial/v2/registry/main/search with body {"query":"<term>","rows":50,"start":0} — the parameter is `query`, NOT `keyword`/`text`/`search` (those are ignored and silently return the whole 4,124-record corpus). Response fields include prozorroId, tenderName, trStatus, ptrAmount/ptrCurrency/ptrTax, publishDate, enquiryEnd, tradeBeg, awardEnd, cpvList, itemNameList, procurementMethodType and okpo. (4) Per-tender detail: GET https://tender.privatbank.ua/commercial/ptr/get-ptr.json?ad-id=<numeric adId> — the parameter is `ad-id` with a hyphen; `adId`, `id` and `ptr-hash` all fail. It returns lots, items with full technical specification text, CPV, document titles and periods.
